ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution covering approximately 90% of the visible surface, contrasted with localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters representing approximately 10% of the surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity field with distinct high-intensity (white) circular ring structures in the lower-left and lower-right quadrants. Discrete high-intensity linear streaks are mapped to the upper-inner regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-vertex angle of 52 degrees, extending deep into the medial fluke connection.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing boundary. Left lobe exhibits two deep macro-indentations (notches) at mid-span. Right lobe exhibits smaller, more uniform sawtooth-style pixel amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory from the median notch extending to pointed distal tips; the left lobe displays a slightly higher vertical sweep relative to the image baseline.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel clusters (approx. 12 on the right lobe, 8 on the left lobe) varying in diameter, predominantly in the lower vertical half of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct groups of high-contrast linear pixel disruptions: a series of 5-6 vertical parallel lines on the inner-left lobe and 4 diagonal parallel lines on the inner-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of circular rosette scarring and linear rake marks across the ventral surface; significant irregular tissue loss or indentations along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-intensity white punctate clusters consistent with calcified organisms located at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
